messages:
kiran: heads-up — tiny-batch perf run showed a short-lived KV cache hit-rate dip during warmup. evictions spike when batch_size=4. can someone take a quick look? tagging @jamal and @maya for profiling + config check.

maya: ok — link to the run? which shard/nodes?

kiran: run link: https://bench.redwood/runs/2026-03-15/1918001 (tiny-batch workload). nodes: 3,7. config snippet:
```
batch_size: 4
prefetch_window_ms: 5
kv_cache_size_mb: 128
eviction_policy: LFRU
coalesce_tokens: 256
```

jamal: I'll grab a profile on node-7. can you start pprof and leave it running for ~60s? command I use:
```
ssh node-7
sudo systemctl restart redwood-runtime && curl http://localhost:6060/debug/pprof/profile?seconds=60 -o /tmp/pprof-node7.pb
```

ops-bot: pprof collector started on node-7; URL: http://pprof.node7.local/profile/1918004321

bench-bot: run summary: tiny-batch run #1918001 — latency +12% vs baseline, kv_hit_rate -8%, kv_evictions/sec +3.2x.

lucas: saw the same on my local replay. eviction/sec jumps around t=10-18s then recovers. looks like prefetching is thrashing small hot entries: prefetch + LFRU churn. quick mitigation: bump prefetch_window_ms to 15 or skip prefetch when request.tokens < 64.

anya: canary those two variants. I'll spin up a microbench with prefetch_window_ms:15 and another with prefetch disabled for tiny requests. tagging @maya for rollout config.

maya: approve canaries. please add metrics: shard.kv_evictions and shard.kv_hit_rate to the canary dashboard. :thumbsup:

jamal: pprof output (short): flamegraph shows heavy time in kv::Entry::reinsert and allocations from kv::Fragment::append — suggests fragmentation + refcount churn during reinserts. pushing heap profile to http://pprof.node7.local/heap/1918004321

kiran: nice, that matches my hunch. if fragmentation is the root cause, a short-term fix is to reduce prefetch aggressiveness for tiny batches and add a cheap LRU bias for very small entries. longer term we should fix fragmentation in alloc arena.

lucas: i'll draft a unit test that emulates 2000 alternating tiny requests to exercise reinserts and eviction churn. will open PR and tag @jamal for review.

jamal: ping me in the PR, i'll take a look today.

anya: canary deploy queued: canary-314 -> nodes {3,7}. configs: variant-A (prefetch_window_ms=15), variant-B (prefetch_disabled_for_tokens_lt=64). metrics wired.

ops-bot: canary-314 started at 2026-03-15T14:12:00Z; tracking metrics: shard.kv_evictions, shard.kv_hit_rate, runtime.latency_p50.

kiran: action items: (1) anya to run canaries (ETA 30m), (2) lucas to open unit-test PR, (3) jamal to validate flamegraph + confirm heap fragmentation hypothesis, (4) maya to add canary dashboard panels. will reconvene async here when canary numbers are in. thanks all :eyes:
